name: Stand Up Comedy @ The Bistro
summary:
Comedy night at The Bistro, Allyn, WA. Paul Goodwin headlines with Bruce Detore & Joe Crudo. May 23, doors 6 PM/show 7 PM. $30, apps included.

Stoned Goose Productions Presents: Stand-Up Comedy Night at The Bistro

Get ready to laugh. Stoned Goose Productions is bringing a stacked lineup of stand-up comedy to The Bistro at Lakeland Village in Allyn, WA on Saturday, May 23rd.

Headlining the night is Paul Goodwin, with featured sets from Bruce Detore and Joe Crudo. Special guest spots from Rob Mawn and Jacob Barber, all hosted by Samuel Tweed.

The Details:

📅 Saturday, May 23rd
🍽️ Doors, bar, and appetizers at 6 PM
🎤 Show starts at 7 PM
🎟️ $30 appetizers included
📍 The Bistro at Lakeland Village, 470 E Country Club Dr, Allyn, WA 98524
Tickets are sold at the bar. Grab a drink, grab some food, and settle in for a night of live comedy from some of the Pacific Northwest's funniest working comedians.

For more info, call (360) 277-4137 or visit stonedgooseproductions.com.

21+ recommended. Seating is limited; arrive early.
